shortDescription: Creates or removes a relationship association from Nautobot

options.name: destination_id
options.description: The UUID of the destination of the relationship Required if I(state=present) and the relationship association does not exist yet

options.name: destination_type
options.description: The app_label.model for the destination of the relationship Required if I(state=present) and the relationship association does not exist yet

options.name: id
options.description: The UUID of the object to operate on

options.name: query_params
options.description: This can be used to override the specified values in ALLOWED_QUERY_PARAMS that is defined in plugins/module_utils/utils.py and provides control to users on what may make an object unique in their environment.

options.name: relationship
options.description: The Relationship UUID to add the association to Required if I(state=present) and the relationship association does not exist yet

options.name: source_id
options.description: The UUID of the source of the relationship Required if I(state=present) and the relationship association does not exist yet

options.name: source_type
options.description: The app_label.model for the source of the relationship Required if I(state=present) and the relationship association does not exist yet

options.name: state
options.description: Use C(present) or C(absent) for adding or removing.

options.name: token
options.description: The token created within Nautobot to authorize API access Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_TOKEN) environment variable is configured.

options.name: url
options.description: The URL of the Nautobot instance resolvable by the Ansible host (for example: http://nautobot.example.com:8000) Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_URL) environment variable is configured.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Can be omitted if the E(NAUTOBOT_VALIDATE_CERTS) environment variable is configured.
